description: This file defines the ContactForm class, representing a form object used to capture user input for contacting purposes on a web application. It includes fields for user name, email, subject, comment, and CAPTCHA response data, with validation annotations.

classes.name: ContactForm
classes.description: A Java POJO class representing a contact form with validation constraints. It encapsulates user input fields such as name, email, subject, comment, and CAPTCHA data.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name entered in the contact form.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name in the contact form.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address entered in the contact form.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address in the contact form.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment text from the contact form.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment text in the contact form.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject entered in the contact form.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject in the contact form.

methods.name: getCaptchaChallengeField
methods.description: Returns the CAPTCHA challenge field value.

methods.name: setCaptchaChallengeField
methods.description: Sets the CAPTCHA challenge field value.
